column4: Bypass build enrolls at the region screen with no prompt (host 21, 34 s after the package applied), and MDM is On before any user exists. Caveat: unencrypted package opened from Shift+F10; the ICD-encrypted package failed with 0x80070490.
PKG-B (unencrypted) kept in ProgramData\Microsoft\Provisioning, readable by every user; C:\Recovery empty. PKG-N location still to record after E-2.

No-bypass build: Fleet blocks enrollment until the IdP sign-in, which happens in Edge on the setup screen (26H2 has a browser there). Host 22 enrolled 28 s after sign-in with the IdP user linked and MDM On, before any user account.
Not needed as planned: the sign-in happened on the setup screen (E-2). Covered again by W-3, which signs in after a reset.

Both packages kept as C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Provisioning\<name>.ppkg, the folder Microsoft names for doWipePersistProvisionedData. C:\Recovery stays empty. Users and Everyone can read the file, so any signed-in user can extract the MSI and its enroll secret (unencrypted packages; encrypted not tested, see E-1).
Generalized image does not boot in UTM on arm64; switched to running host lineages one after another.
Fresh bypass host 23: enrolled and MDM On during setup with no prompt; lab1 desktop reached with no prompt. Ready for W-1.
